binary_txmp_family.matrix_state: unit scale, zero translation, +/-pi Y rotation across two source revisions
binary_txmp_family.mapping_note: The absent matching old DSC prevents a unique t2d-number-to-mesh assignment, but the transformed ASCII mesh family, matching HRC geometry/UVs and old TXMP pi-Y family are from the same Stasis source lineage.

conclusion: The Softimage-to-binary conversion preserves the source SI_MeshTextureCoords in HRC essentially verbatim while retaining non-identity SI_Texture2D transform state separately in TXMP. The live texture matrix is therefore not baked into the binary HRC polygon UVs and must remain an additional reconstruction/runtime texture effect.
production_implications: Do not discard non-identity TXMP state merely because a class-4 HRC contains nonzero TEXCOORD_0.
For code401/nonzero-UV paths, HRC UVs are a valid pre-effect/current-UV source candidate; live SI_Texture2D effects remain separately required.
For code401/all-zero HRC UV paths, the live projection generator itself must be reconstructed before those texture effects can be applied.

The pi-Y example is self-inverse and cannot alone establish the general 3D UVW matrix direction; code400 face39 supplies the asymmetric object-to-projection direction oracle for model-local projection generation.
